title: WAN
requirement: Primary internet uplink via Ethernet, minimum 1 Gbps. Cellular backup is optional for this profile; mandatory only for a Cellular Backup variant (not yet defined).

detail.label: Cellular backup (optional)
detail.value: M.2 (B-key) modem, USB bus interface, MBIM/QMI protocol, physical SIM

referenceImplementation: BPI-R4: Quectel EM05-G, validated in North America and APAC regions via wwan0 and USB RNDIS tethering
notes: Ethernet is the primary internet connection. Cellular failover and USB phone tethering are optional capabilities, not required for the base profile.

title: LAN
requirement: Ethernet ports for wired LAN devices.
notes: Ethernet ports for wired devices on the home network.

title: Wi-Fi
requirement: IEEE 802.11n/ac/ax/be support, subject to required bands and profile configuration.

detail.label: Mesh
detail.value: EasyMesh Controller functionality is required for the GW EasyMesh profile, and not required for this profile unless EasyMesh is enabled

notes: Wi-Fi access point for wireless devices. Supporting 802.11be does not by itself mean every band and legacy mode has been separately validated.

title: Bluetooth / IoT
requirement: Radio supporting Bluetooth LE and IEEE 802.15.4 (Thread/Zigbee), for smart-home device connections and Matter commissioning.
notes: Simultaneous Bluetooth, Thread, and Zigbee operation has not been specifically validated as a coexistence scenario -- each protocol has been exercised individually (Matter over Wi-Fi validates the Wi-Fi interface, not this radio; Matter over Thread validates the Thread Border Router and 802.15.4; BLE commissioning and Zigbee pairing validate the radio directly).

title: Packet Processor
requirement: Hardware-accelerated forwarding (routing/NAT) is required to meet the profile's throughput requirements without relying on the CPU for per-packet processing.
referenceImplementation: BPI-R4: built into the SoC (MediaTek MT7988A)
notes: Speeds up routing and NAT by handling it in hardware instead of software.

title: AI / NPU
notes: A future board revision could add one as a plug-in module, for on-device AI features.

title: USB
referenceImplementation: BPI-R4: used for the cellular backup modem's USB bus interface, Android phone tethering, and IoT test devices

title: SIM Card Slot
requirement: Required only if cellular backup is implemented.
referenceImplementation: BPI-R4: physical SIM slot for the Quectel EM05-G
notes: Holds the SIM for the cellular backup modem, where present.

title: Storage
requirement: Non-volatile storage for firmware and configuration, sized to the profile's flash minimum, with A/B update support and a recovery path.
referenceImplementation: BPI-R4: eMMC / SPI-NAND, see Section 3.7 for measured partition sizes
notes: Media type and A/B update capability are separate requirements -- a device could use different flash media and still meet the A/B/recovery requirement independently.

title: SD Card Slot
referenceImplementation: BPI-R4: SD card slot, used for development, recovery, and validation on the reference platform
notes: Optional; a reference-board capability, not something every compatible device needs.

title: Media Tuner
requirement: Integrated DOCSIS, DSL, PON, or media-tuner hardware is not required for this profile.
notes: Fiber can still reach this profile through an external ONT and Ethernet WAN -- this profile just doesn't require integrated PON/tuner hardware itself.

title: Debug Port
requirement: UART is required during bring-up; production exposure is vendor/security-policy dependent. JTAG is optional for development and must be disabled or access-controlled in production where security requirements apply.

detail.label: JTAG
detail.value: Optional for development; access-controlled in production

notes: Debug access for development; production posture depends on the vendor's security policy.

title: WPS Button
requirement: Optional unless required by the product profile. If implemented, the button event must be accessible to platform software and comply with the applicable Wi-Fi security policy.
notes: A physical button for quick Wi-Fi setup, where implemented.

title: Reset Button
requirement: If implemented, short-press and long-press behavior, factory-reset trigger, whether credentials/persistent settings are erased, and recovery behavior if pressed during boot must all be defined and testable.

detail.label: Long press (factory reset)
detail.value: TBD -- duration and erasure scope vendor-defined

notes: Exact press-duration thresholds and erasure scope are not yet specified for this profile.

title: Power Button
requirement: Optional; reference-platform dependent. Many gateways use an external power adapter with no software-visible power switch.

title: Thermal / Cooling
requirement: The platform shall remain within its specified operating temperature and performance limits under sustained maximum workload. Cooling may be passive or active.
notes: This is a thermal performance requirement, not a mandate for a specific cooling method.
